verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml is repeatedly cited as a live machine-readable spec (docs-26 through docs-31), which serves as agent-parsable documentation, but the dedicated llms.txt endpoint that this story explicitly names returns a 404 per direct probe, and there is no evidence of a curated agent-oriented docs page beyond the raw OpenAPI file. missing for 10: a working llms.txt file, any first-party statement that the OpenAPI/docs are meant for direct agent consumption, and independent confirmation an agent can successfully ingest it.
